name: Exact discrete equality
proposed_value_or_rule: Exact equality
rationale: Identifiers enums counts booleans and reason codes are discrete
applies_to: Enum integer ID schema and status assertions
notes: No floating comparison

name: Deterministic serialization equality
proposed_value_or_rule: Byte equality under the same frozen environment and canonical serializer version
rationale: Required for R1 hashes and manifests
applies_to: JSON CSV NDJSON headers effective config hashes NUM-001 PRO-004
notes: UTF-8 no BOM invariant round-trip numeric format and declared newline

name: Binary64 arithmetic tolerance
proposed_value_or_rule: abs(a-b) <= 1e-12 + 1e-12*max(abs(a),abs(b))
rationale: Conservative allowance for ordinary deterministic double operations without masking model error
applies_to: Hand calculations L J Bayes toy probabilities REL BEL OBJ DEC VOI
notes: Not an analytical approximation tolerance

name: Probability bound tolerance
proposed_value_or_rule: Value must be finite and within [-1e-12,1+1e-12]; values outside fail; tiny boundary excursions may be snapped only after diagnostic
rationale: Separates roundoff from invalid probability
notes: Snapping is never metric clipping

name: Reliability complement tolerance
rationale: E7 identity should be arithmetic-level exact
notes: R should normally be constructed as 1-P_f

name: Belief normalization tolerance
proposed_value_or_rule: abs(sum(weights)-1) <= 1e-12 and every weight finite/nonnegative
rationale: Weighted posterior must be a probability measure
notes: Normalize once with logged pre-normalization sum; gross invalidity fails

name: Consequence weight simplex tolerance
proposed_value_or_rule: abs(sum(weights)-1) <= 1e-12 and all weights finite/nonnegative
rationale: Prevents ambiguous objective scale
notes: Scientific weight values themselves have no default

name: Bayes evidence support rule
proposed_value_or_rule: Use log-sum-exp; fail NotEvaluable when every log prior-weight plus log-likelihood is nonfinite
rationale: Absolute density thresholds are scale dependent; log support is safer
notes: Do not silently return prior

name: Analytical toy agreement
proposed_value_or_rule: abs(error) <= 1e-9 + 1e-9*abs(reference)
rationale: Stricter than scientific MC while allowing validated numerical integration
applies_to: REL-008 BEL-004 OBJ-004 VOI-001 deterministic analytical fixtures
notes: Fixture expected values are TEST_FIXTURE_ONLY

name: Quadrature integration tolerance
proposed_value_or_rule: absolute tolerance 1e-10 and relative tolerance 1e-8; both diagnostics reported
rationale: Appropriate binary64 design target for approved scalar fallback
applies_to: REL-018 scalar quadrature Bayes finite-support integration
adjustable: YES before T5/T6 with convergence evidence
notes: Maximum subdivisions/evaluations are configuration fields

name: Minimum posterior predictive paths
proposed_value_or_rule: 4096 paths
rationale: Prevents decisions from very small path samples and supports batch diagnostics
adjustable: YES only before T5 with T3 evidence
notes: Power-of-two implementation setting; not scientific trajectory N

name: Monte Carlo batch size
proposed_value_or_rule: 2048 paths per deterministic batch
rationale: Balances bounded memory diagnostics and cancellation granularity
adjustable: YES only before T5 with T3 evidence
notes: Batch identity enters stream key

name: Maximum posterior predictive paths
proposed_value_or_rule: 1048576 paths per policy/decision evaluation
rationale: Hard resource guard while allowing near-boundary refinement
adjustable: YES before T5/T6 based only on numerical feasibility
notes: Hitting limit unresolved returns NumericalNonConvergence

name: Consecutive stable batches
proposed_value_or_rule: 3 consecutive completed batches satisfying classification and objective rules
rationale: Reduces accidental early stopping
adjustable: YES before T5 with T3 evidence
notes: Checked only after N_min

name: Failure-probability numerical interval
proposed_value_or_rule: One-sided 99% Wilson upper bound for feasibility; two-sided Wilson diagnostics retained
rationale: Conservative chance-constraint classification without inventing a new risk measure
notes: Feasible iff UCB <= epsilon or epsilon_rem

name: Failure-probability stopping rule
proposed_value_or_rule: After N_min stop only when UCB<=tolerance or LCB>tolerance and that classification is stable for TOL-MC-STABLE batches; otherwise continue to N_max
rationale: Precision automatically increases near the chance boundary
notes: Epsilon is scientific owner input and is never changed

name: Expected-disutility ordering rule
proposed_value_or_rule: Use paired 99% interval for J differences under CRN; require interval half-width <= 0.10*Delta_star and stable order for 3 batches; at N_max unresolved feasible policies are SuccessNumericalTie
rationale: Connects numerical precision to predeclared practical meaning without fake loss scale
notes: Delta_star is scientific and AUTHOR DATA REQUIRED BEFORE T6

name: First-passage resolution refinement
proposed_value_or_rule: Refine segment resolution until two consecutive refinements change P_f by no more than its registered MC/analytical tolerance and crossing classification is stable; otherwise NumericalNonConvergence at limit
rationale: Prevents terminal-only or coarse-grid missed crossings
adjustable: YES before T5 by transition-method review
notes: Exposure step itself is model-specific and not defaulted here

name: Deterministic tie tolerance
proposed_value_or_rule: abs(J1-J2) <= max(1e-12,8 ULP at max magnitude) for nonstochastic evaluators
rationale: Makes binary64 tie behavior stable without hiding material differences
notes: Monte Carlo ties use TOL-MC-J

name: Log-score metric clipping
proposed_value_or_rule: Clip reported metric input probability to [1e-15,1-1e-15] only inside log-score calculation
rationale: Avoids infinite metric while preserving original probability output
adjustable: YES before T6 and must be disclosed
notes: Never used by reliability engine or selector

name: Same-environment deterministic CRN equality
proposed_value_or_rule: Exact stream known-answer vectors and byte-identical ordered raw records for fixed environment/config
rationale: Detects scheduling or enumeration dependence
notes: Cross-environment R2 uses aggregate tolerances

name: Bootstrap Monte Carlo plan
proposed_value_or_rule: 9999 stratified paired trajectory-cluster resamples; percentile 95% interval
rationale: Stable prospective inference design with deterministic named streams
applies_to: STA-003 primary statistical analysis calibration bands
adjustable: YES only before T6 protocol lock
notes: Scientific confidence level is frozen protocol choice not field fact

name: Multiplicity family
proposed_value_or_rule: Familywise alpha 0.05 with Holm step-down across three primary paired-disutility contrasts
rationale: Controls frozen primary family
notes: No post-hoc primary contrasts

name: Censoring estimator acceptance
proposed_value_or_rule: No fixed numeric tolerance; selected estimator must pass fixture known-answer and weight-positivity/stability checks registered before T6
rationale: Data structure determines IPCW or interval-censored method
adjustable: YES before T6 after censoring audit
notes: Informative unresolved censoring makes metrics NotEvaluable
